cover.alt: Granite towers glowing red at dawn

chapters.heading: The 3 a.m. climb
chapters.body: Headtorches bobbing up the moraine in a long silent line, everyone racing the same thing: the first light on the towers.

image.caption: The last hour is the steepest.

chapters.heading: Alpenglow
chapters.body: For about four minutes the whole massif turned the colour of embers. Then the wind arrived and reminded us where we were.
